styleGuide.palette: deep midnight teal sea, cold slate-blue fog, warm amber lighthouse glow (#ffcf6b) as the single accent
styleGuide.mood: lonely, hand-painted maritime night; cinematic but readable on a small phone screen
styleGuide.rendering: painterly digital illustration, soft volumetric light, no photographic textures, no text, no watermark

backgrounds.prompt: Vertical mobile game background: a lonely stone lighthouse on a rocky headland at the LEFT edge, clear starry night, calm dark teal open sea filling the centre and lower two thirds, distant horizon line in the upper third, jagged black rocks along the right edge. Warm amber glow spilling from the lighthouse lantern room. Painterly, cinematic, cool midnight palette with one warm amber accent. Keep the centre of the sea uncluttered and low-detail — gameplay objects will be drawn on top. No ships, no boats, no text, no UI. Paint a RICH TONAL RANGE: many subtle value steps and colour variation across sky, water and rock; crisp well-defined edges and clear separation between silhouette, mid-ground and horizon. Avoid flat uniform colour blocks and avoid soft focus.
